layer: Local production build and desktop/mobile Chromium emulation

checks.playwrightResult: PASS 44/44 in one complete final run

visualReview: Adult female with realistic human proportions, light skin, brown eyes and a subtle smile
Complete hair from front, profile and rear; normal connected body and civil clothing
No visible intersecting sock cuffs in the final exported model
Native facial shape targets, eyelids, eyelashes, teeth and tongue
Body walk and turns, bent-elbow pointing and conversational hand gestures
Opaque skin/eyes/teeth and depth-tested strand cutouts; no hidden geometry visible through the face
Static fallback from the same character and no model download with reduced motion
No page errors or horizontal overflow in actual browser captures
speechVerification: Simulated native browser start, word boundary, cancel/end events and language-specific voice availability. Visemes within words are estimated; no actual acoustic output measured.

corrections.issue: Initial glTF materials all used BLEND and revealed hidden face geometry / occluded the front hair.
corrections.fix: Skin, lips, eyes and teeth use OPAQUE. Hair, brows and lashes use MASK with depth writes. GLB unit test guards these semantics.

releaseBinding: GitHub Actions repeats checks and deploys its tested artifact at the exact main SHA; release.json and production-runtime-<SHA> artifact record the runtime. Public browser checks are performed after deployment, separate from this local evidence.
